purpose: Phase-7A penetration-modifier combination model. Combines the passive ECM / diffusion / mechanical / hypoxia resistances into a single schematic drug-penetration modifier and an ordinal microenvironment state. The penetration modifier influences EFFECTIVE extracellular drug availability / penetration probability / intracellular exposure ONLY - it NEVER modifies drug chemistry, binding affinity, protein interactions, or genetic regulation. Schematic; no absolute penetration rate.
penetration_note: penetration_modifier = clamp(1 - combined_restriction, penetration_floor, 1); 1 = no restriction (full penetration), lower = reduced effective penetration.

state_thresholds.thresholds_basis: SCHEMATIC ordinal boundaries on the combined passive restriction [0,1]; above highly_restrictive = extremely_restrictive. NOT measured penetration fractions.

stop_boundary: microenvironment modifies penetration (effective extracellular drug availability / penetration probability / intracellular exposure)
